fields.statement: At edc98e1b ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^daemon-status$' -count=1: PASS. The script, after rhiza daemon --once, asserts 'Web UI: http://127.0.0.1:7787' in text and "web": "http://127.0.0.1:7787" in --json; after daemon set rhiza.web.host 0.0.0.0 and another --once, http://0.0.0.0:7787 in both; after daemon set rhiza.web.host ::1 and another --once, http://[::1]:7787 in both. Read the code: webStatus in internal/api/daemon.go builds the URL from the recorded host and port settings via web.Addr, which uses net.JoinHostPort, so IPv6 hosts are bracketed and an empty host defaults to 127.0.0.1.
